purpose: Display a keyboard key or shortcut notation in text.
avoid: Notation does not itself register a shortcut.
basis: Pinned React/primitive sources lead API, lifecycle and semantics; native visual observations and explicit reference decisions are mapped in figma/traceability.json.
profileRationale: Meaningful native content or a content container in its default source mode. Interactive descendants/native render overrides keep their own native or component contracts; no decorative fallback or invented selection API.
contentAlternative: Native kbd text describes the key/shortcut in surrounding task text. Symbols need a spoken text explanation when ambiguous.
updatesAndDescendants: Kbd and KbdGroup render native kbd elements and do not register shortcuts, move focus or handle key events. Changing children changes the notation only.
referenceDecision: The Ctrl+S notation is an example, not a newly registered shortcut. KbdGroup is typed with div props upstream but actually renders kbd; this known source distinction is retained.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: The actual two exports render native kbd elements.20px minimum keycap height,6px corners,4px inline inset and12/16px text retain native metrics. The21px specimen width is glyph-dependent and stays in evidence. Group notation wraps at its host boundary, while no tabstop, role=button or automatic shortcut handling is added.
